scripts.build: npm run build -w nepdate-core && npm run build -w nepdate-patro
scripts.test: npm test -w nepdate-core && npm test -w nepdate-patro
scripts.mutation: npm run build && stryker run stryker.core.conf.mjs && stryker run stryker.patro.conf.mjs
scripts.mutation:force: npm run build && stryker run stryker.core.conf.mjs --force && stryker run stryker.patro.conf.mjs --force
scripts.mutation:check: node scripts/mutation-check.ts --core reports/mutation/core.json --patro reports/mutation/patro.json --floor docs/mutation/floor.json --equivalent docs/mutation/equivalent.md
